label: Stop instance infra
description: Scale one instance's copy of an infra node down, keeping its disk. The instance's triggers reading it go down with it, the way `triggers` says; the instance's runs using it follow `running`.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node marked `@per_instance`, named the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: What happens to the instance's triggers reading it: park keeps what arrives for later, hibernate keeps it for a grace window, wipe drops it.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: What happens to the instance's runs still going: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them now. Wipe needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: How long hibernate keeps accepting what arrives. Ignored by park and wipe.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: Off: this run keeps going even when it is one of the runs reached. On: this run ends with them, cancelled.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the instance's triggers reading the copy are down and the stop is handed to the supervisor, which scales the copy down on its own time. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.

then.message: StopInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
